name: session-objective
description: Every session has one objective file, split four ways: the operator's own messages, an OBJECTIVE and a four-checkpoint WORKFLOW written from them by a call that has never seen the session, and the agent's PROGRESS. The agent may not touch the first three, may not change a file in the project until it has recorded a passing proof that it looked at what it is changing, and may not end a turn while the objective is ACTIVE.
